column2: Open AP invoices are OPEN (unpaid) balances at go-live cutover date only. Do NOT include paid invoices. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py open_ap_invoices this_file.csv 3
Company: Workday Company Reference ID — must exist in your tenant before loading
Supplier_ID: Must exactly match a Supplier_ID from the Supplier Master load
Invoice_Amount: Total invoice amount. Positive value only. Use the gross amount (before any credits)
Tax_Amount: Enter 0.00 if no tax, not blank
Match_Type: Use No_Match for all historical open invoices being converted (they have no PO matching history)
Due_Date: Must be >= Invoice_Date. Many historical invoices will have past-due dates — this is expected and correct
Spend_Category: Must match a valid Workday Spend Category Reference ID in your tenant
Reconciliation check: Sum of Invoice_Amount column must equal Open AP balance on legacy trial balance (by currency)
Load order: Object 5 — load AFTER Supplier Master, Cost Centers, and Spend Category config
